items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: it swung a lot more than the Tommy Dorsey band, that book.

ctx.x: Oh okay. You can always edit it out. Okay so he says what’s your favorite and she says The “William Tell Overture” and he said okay so there were seven girls. So he had one of the girls facing — her butt facing the audience you know, the audience I’m talking about just all men in there you know with hats in their laps. Then the other girls facing forward. I’m 16. Now another girl facing forward. And then another one facing with the butt facing us and then three girls in a row facing forward. So he goes,…
was a wonderful book, more so — it swung a lot more than the Tommy Dorsey band, that book.

Well you can’t learn that, I don’t think they teach that in jazz education now, maybe there’s not a reason for it, but I’m envious that you had that experience and that down the road some of the things you did you say well this is easy compared to being in the pit.
